about: City layer for Santa Ana. Zone descriptions come from the city's own zoning service. The category for each zone is OUR mapping of that description, not a city determination: 'review' means the zone needs a person to read the code (specific plans, specific developments, mixed zones).

zoning_source.title: City of Santa Ana: Zoning Classifications (ArcGIS FeatureServer)

incorporated.source: Santa Ana is an incorporated city (it publishes its own zoning ordinance and GIS).

urbanized.source: US Census TIGERweb, 2020 Urban Areas (Corrected), layer 88: a point in central Santa Ana (-117.8678, 33.7455) returns 'Los Angeles--Long Beach--Anaheim, CA Urban Area' (UA 51445). Queried 2026-11-07.
urbanized.note: The 2020 Census replaced 'urbanized area' and 'urban cluster' with a single 'urban area' type. Confirm how the statute's term maps to it.

RE.note: ASSUMPTION: treated as single-family from the name. Confirm in the Santa Ana Municipal Code.

R2.note: Allows two units. Whether it counts as 'multifamily' for SB 684 needs a person to check.

P.note: Professional (office) zone. AB 2011 covers zones that allow office uses.

SD*.note: Each Specific Development has its own rules. Read the ordinance.

SP*.note: Each Specific Plan has its own rules. Read the plan.
